mapper.sql: id, biz_type, caller_id, caller_name, caller_type, caller_level, caller_dept_code, caller_dept_name, req_summary, resp_summary, cost_time_ms, result_status, error_code, gmt_create, gmt_modified
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCalls, COUNT(DISTINCT caller_id) AS totalCallers, SUM(CASE WHEN result_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, COALESCE(AVG(cost_time_ms), 0) AS avgCostTimeMs FROM call_record WHERE gmt_create >= #{start} AND gmt_create <= #{end}
SELECT caller_name AS name, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM call_record WHERE gmt_create >= #{start} AND gmt_create <= #{end} GROUP BY caller_id, caller_name ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 1
